label: Fifth Way existential target without global uniqueness
summary:
The existing common-governor conclusion lacked a projection to the root-route first-mover node. Added that assembly and a substantive seven-premise first-mover inference importing QuintaViaEachDirected.eachDirected. Global first-mover uniqueness is not used for existential first-mover status. Controls keep the other six premises on each of seven omissions and lack a first mover, plus a populated nonvacuity interpretation and two-director survivor with first movers but no global uniqueness. Reject treating the reduced existential conclusion as common-governor scope, modal necessity, concreteness or classical theism. Source-free analyst target audit; source claims and old Challenges unchanged. Full strongest-case/rival reconstruction, exact theorem/premise comparison, witnesses and remaining applicability and strength gaps persist in docs/notes/teleology-first-mover.md. Witness-local continuation: one same body/end suffices; explicit reduction and motion bridges remain. A second natural body without regular outcomes witnesses strictness of local against universal scope. Local omissions reuse old fixtures with the genuinely narrower constraints, including teleonomy, dichotomy and mutable-director controls. See WitnessLocalTeleology and the continuation in the existing note; applicability remains open. 2026-11-17 cross-family continuation: retain the local unmoved director’s intellect and use the existing first-mover/maximum identity plus God-to-maximality to conclude the existing GOD_4 HasIntellect conditional; add a modular HasIntellect plus will-follows-intellect consumer for existing GOD_4 HasWill. The existing classical-attributes consumer can now use this support option without the immateriality-to-intellect route. No separate universal observation/common-governor premise, concrete esse-ground adapter, modal transfer or identification of GOD_2 with GOD_4 is used; first-mover/maximum identity retains its substantial existing provenance and conditional uniqueness strength. New fixed two-being controls check nonvacuity and omissions of each of the three carrying inputs. Rejected duplicate global-governor/positive-root composition (already implemented); rejected applying the intellect-forgetting firstMover projection or identifying arbitrary director/GOD_4 witnesses; deferred unlicensed Rowe/hiddenness attribute identification and intentional-creation composition. Complete proposed outcome, positive rationale, substantive teleonomy rival mechanism, exact scopes and revision conditions are persisted in docs/notes/teleology-first-mover.md. Independent semantic review accepted the compositions; coordinator repaired the continuation recommendation to require a specified new discriminant before reopening local application. That historical handoff recorded integration as pending; the adapter is now reused from refreshed main. Finality continuation 2026-11-25: materialized/read the existing q2a3 and Physics II8–9 pinned passages and consulted q5a4–5, I-IIq1a2, q44a4, Physics commentary II14§268 and SCGIII24 with their relevant context. Present form and natural appetite give a positive immanent ground; the intellectual reconstruction requires the original-ordering premise that noncognitive orientation is received and depends on an intellectual principal. The absent-future and archer shortcuts do not establish that exclusion. Linked the existing biological due-capacity mechanism to the recipient/source relevance distinction and competence-versus-support test. Preserved same body/end, Best versus benefit, knowing-director and separate unmoved intellectual reduction, maximum identity and capacity versus actual practical governance. No new theorem, claim or graph edge; consult the linked continuation for complete scope and primary locators. Simplicity/forms follow-up in docs/notes/teleology-first-mover.md#one-simple-source-and-the-differences-between-its-effects-2026-11-25-provisional adds q.14 a.6’s distinguishing-determination requirement and the q.14–15 one-principle/many-objects explanation. It tests, rather than assumes, the reversal from productive forms to source cognition. The lamp/filter comparison is a restricted explanatory illustration, not an ultimate-source model or new experiment. Existing q.14 a.1 was materialized and full contextual articles read; the note distinguishes the registered selector from contextual XML and q.15 consultation. No source claim, formal edge or premise discharge is added. Joint-specification continuation uses De veritate q.5 a.2, SCG II.24 and the existing q.19/q.7 controls to test beneficial coordination and finite measure. The strongest rival makes the whole good a proper joint manifestation; no inference from finite effects to received source restriction, or from recipient inquiry to source cognition, is established. Exact source reading scopes and full existing bundle remain in the linked note.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (a) LocalTeleologyGodIntellect.godHasIntellect (11628966) is a substantive conditional proof toward 29818edd: it constructs an intellectual first mover and transports intellect across the supplied identity. (b) godHasWill (dd55f57a) toward 66aecdd7 is a transcription under invariant 16: its proof is `fun g hg => hWill g (hIntellect g hg)`, its open will-follows-intellect premise already states the advertised consequent, and it takes neither the local teleology bundle nor the identity premise. It remains a modular consumer of 11628966. For 11628966 the complete local bundle 65c409cc and same-root identification are needed: a specified noncognitive body/end has a knowing director traced by a separate reduction to the intellectual unmoved bearer. General coordinated outcomes or a material competence example do not supply the local bundle. (e) The owner inference from original recipient-relative finite measure to intrinsic intellect still needs an exclusion of a unitary noncognitive source with actual joint specification. Use the same source and produced nature to test received restriction, real composition or incompatibility with the retained contingency. The reason-bearing source alternative needs independently supported actual uptake, rather than replacing the noncognitive body with a rational recipient. PracticalSpecification.effectDirectionOfPracticalSpecification (785a4e63) supplies an existing conditional consumer with operative coverage (4be0f774), end-omission and directedness-recognition premises; it does not derive 65c409cc or the uptake premise.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). f9c0f1e4 tests b5f01676. In strict, b0 satisfies the seven conditions at the sole end, but the other natural body b1 has no regular attainment. The model separates the witness-local bundle from the stronger universal bundle. f9c0f1e4 tests 658814de. Omit the universal regular-best observation. In strict, the regular predicate holds only for b0, leaving body b1 without a regularly attained best end. The other six global clauses retain the base assignment, with the clauses triggered by regularity restricted to b0. f9c0f1e4 tests 10d955b0. The strict fixture witnesses the argument's local bundle with natural body b0 and the sole end. The unmoved, intelligent d0 directs and moves b0, and this body regularly attains the end without chance. ec5c3154 tests b8394dbb. The two-bearer Bool model jointly witnesses the local bundle, first-mover and maximum identity, and the God-to-maximum clause. False is the noncognitive body, and true is its unmoved intellectual director, the sole maximum and the supplied GOD_4 witness. ec5c3154 tests 46326b43. Omit first-mover and maximum identity. With flat comparison both bearers are maximal. The local bundle still gives true as the intellectual first mover, while IsGod selects only false, the nonintellectual body. ec5c3154 tests 4c79298d. Omit the God-to-maximum clause. At the sole respect, true is the only maximum and remains the intellectual first mover. The supplied IsGod predicate instead selects the nonmaximum, nonintellectual body false. ec5c3154 tests 65c409cc. Omit the local intellectual-director bundle. With an empty intellect predicate, false still tends to its end and receives direction from true, but no intellectual director can witness the local clause. The first-mover identity and God-to-maximum clauses hold with true as maximum and GOD_4 witness. The seven independent LocalExcept omissions range over the selected body and end. These individual local conditions lack standalone root-path statements, so the local omission rows do not target the corresponding universal premises.
blocker: Defend the exact original-measure exclusion: a noncognitive source cannot ground the recipient-relative finite limits without received restriction, forbidden composition, an external determiner or incompatible modal necessity. Alternatively identify actual apprehension as governing K in service of D, or substantiate the rival’s simple joint productive constitution. The same noncognitive body/end and the knowing-director plus separate intellectual-unmoved-reduction clauses remain needed for the existing local bundle; the rational recipient used to articulate D cannot replace that body.

current_assessment.scope: Finite-measure test of original ordering under content-fixed favouring (#2145 Lane 2b); preserves the witness-local Fifth Way connection and complete bundle.
current_assessment.assessment: The finite-measure test's two options for a noncognitive source (received restriction, power ceiling) omit a third: a determination of its favouring to one content, which the D-directed rival has and which fixes D's measures without reception or a ceiling. It meets the end-content reading of acting because of its goodness and fails the controlled goodness reading, as a determined will does. A good-general profile avoids the determination whether or not it is cognitive, explaining a finite measure by goodness only where a better or undominated measure exists and otherwise by a contingent exercise on both sides. So the test does not change the parity; the open points move to the non-coincidence explanandum (E4), the content-generality bridge (compare the earlier finding that productive containment is not yet intentional presence) and the Lane 1 limitation hook.
current_assessment.next_test: Test whether a favouring that is a function of the betterness of arbitrary candidate contents is a cognitive relation; assess E4; after #2153, test whether content determination at an unlimited root is a limitation. The full witness-local bundle and identity/maximality inputs remain required.

assessment_history.assessment: Present form is a positive candidate ground of natural finality, supported locally by the existing due-capacity investigation. Apprehension of an independently specified recipient good can give an actual formative principle and reason for production; original intellectual ordering retains direct and cumulative warrant. Its exclusive ultimate application remains disputed because the intrinsic generative-nature rival denies that every noncognitive ordering is merely received. Neither an unrealized future end, the archer illustration nor biological maintenance establishes that exclusion. The same-body/end Bundle still needs knowing direction and a separate reduction to an intellectual unmoved director, plus the identity/maximality premises for GodHasIntellect; actual practical governance is not its conclusion.
assessment_history.next_test: Test both proposed source constitutions against an independently fixed recipient completion and the difference between restored competence and continued existence through support. A defended original-ordering principle or source-specific actual apprehension as formative measure would strengthen the intellectual application; a warranted unitary generative nature satisfying the same constraints would strengthen the rival. Do not treat another local mechanism, a cognition flag, or beneficial output as the missing first-source recognition.

assessment_history.assessment: Q.14 a.6 rejects a generic common input as sufficient for proper knowledge where distinguishing conditions come from elsewhere. The positive q.14–15 proposal places many understood objects and imitability relations in one actual understanding through one essence; it already presupposes source cognition. A noncognitive generative constitution must likewise account for the differentiating conditions at the same universal scope. That common requirement does not identify productive containment with intentional presence, and neither is actual practical governance by itself. The proposed many-form objection supplies no exclusive first-source cognition conclusion. The full witness-local bundle and identity/maximality inputs remain required; no God-existence witness or source-governance conclusion follows from this continuation.
assessment_history.next_test: Find warrant that the source-specific productive specification must itself be apprehended, or that its noncognitive realization entails real intrinsic multiplicity under a criterion also met by the personal account. Alternatively substantiate a simple noncognitive constitution accounting for the same differences. Keep the original-ordering and actual-governance application questions separate. Another common-source analogy, reversing q.15’s argument into a proof of its own cognition premise, or matching successful outputs cannot supply the missing cognition bridge.

Applying natural-agency necessity to the retained nonnecessitating source is the disputed extension. Genuine recipient inquiry supplies no self-refutation of source noncognition. The tested arguments do not establish exclusive original cognitive direction or actual practical governance.
